verdict.rationale: Pinecone is a managed vector-database service, not an agent, so an official MCP server is an applicable axis. First-party docs describe an official MCP server that lets agents search Pinecone documentation, manage indexes, upsert data and query indexes from MCP clients such as Claude, Cursor, Antigravity and Claude Code. A probe confirmed the dedicated MCP server docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice (all community evidence predates or ignores it).
